prompts: The model configs our coding harnesses use are in {WS}: OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code each get one. They disagree about the context window of fast-coder: OpenCode's config says 262144, the other two say 131072. 262144 is the right value. Make all three agree, for good. Every other model setting stays as it is.
answers:
[goal] fast-coder context window = 262144 in all three harness configs, permanently.

[action] The out/ files are generated from models.json by gen.py (README confirms). The OpenCode file had been hand-edited; the source still said 131072, so any regeneration would have reverted it. Changed models.json line 3 to 262144 and ran `python -I gen.py`.

[result] Diff of out/ before vs after regeneration shows exactly two changes and nothing else:
```
out/claude.json  5c5  "contextWindow": 131072  ->  "contextWindow": 262144
out/codex.toml   2c2  context_window = 131072  ->  context_window = 262144
```
opencode.json regenerated byte-identical (no diff line), so its 262144 was already what the generator produces. deep-thinker, tiny-chat, max_output and tool_calling untouched. Verified by grep:
```
models.json:3:   {"name": "fast-coder", "context_window": 262144, ...}
out/codex.toml:2:  context_window = 262144
out/claude.json:5: "contextWindow": 262144,
out/opencode.json:9: "context": 262144,
```
Assumption: "for good" means fix the source of truth, not just the outputs; done that way, so future `python gen.py` runs keep all three in agreement.
